🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 3, 2026

Sun, in its fall in Libra, holds a square to Moon, at home in Cancer. Two ways of valuing a thing, meeting at one point: the wanting and the sum are audible in the same room.

Easier — Noticing which of your commitments you never actually chose.
Harder — Forcing a decision that only needs to be described honestly.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Sun faces you from Libra: your measure comes back as someone else’s. Fire opens the file, and the file has a price. The Cancer chapter closed four weeks ago.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is a foreigner in Scorpio and improvises. Moon sextiles you from Cancer: a door left ajar. Earth keeps what it has, cheaply. Four weeks of Libra ended, and nothing carried over.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Sun in Libra sides with you before you have argued. Air bends, and bending costs nothing here. Mercury left Virgo four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, is at home in Cancer. From Libra, Sun cuts across the appetite. Cardinal water starts and is invoiced for it. The opposition of a week ago is off it now.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Libra, without leverage of its own. Sun in Libra opens a gap you have to step into. Fixed fire: nothing needs letting go of today. Sun has been out of Virgo for four weeks now.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, is only passing through Scorpio. Moon sextiles you from Cancer: help that waits to be asked for. Mutable earth: two answers, and both are affordable. What pressed two weeks ago has cleared.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Sun crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Air starts and settles in the same breath. Two weeks ago Venus was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you from Leo on plain terms, without privilege. From Cancer, Moon makes it easy, which is not the same as right. Water keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. Sun let go of it a week ago.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Sun in Libra makes room for you, and then waits. Fire that changes shape, and the shape fits. The hold Saturn had a week ago is not there any more.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Sun squares you from Libra: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Cardinal earth meets a bill. The trine to Jupiter that held a week ago has let go.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Sun trines you from Libra, and what you hold finds words unforced. Fixed air holds, and holding asks nothing back. New since last week: none of it is habit yet.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, holds no rank in Leo and simply works. Moon trines you from Cancer, meeting no resistance. Water adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.
